event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review this in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target, to plan evaluation of your right-upper-belly pain after fatty meals and to plan follow-up and review any results ordered. If that review isn't available to you, contact your own doctor or a local clinic to arrange the same evaluation. Get emergency care now if your belly becomes stiff, hard and tender to touch. Seek same-day in-person assessment if pain becomes constant for more than a few hours, or you develop fever, yellowing of skin or eyes, or persistent vomiting.
